bullets.text: Test & Measurement Highlights - 2025 was a pivotal year for test and measurement, showcasing significant advancements and challenges.
HCLTech Acquires HPE Unit - The acquisition aims to enhance AI-driven network automation for telecom operations.
AI Dominates CES 2026 - Companies must strategize to stand out amidst the overwhelming AI focus at CES 2026.
Wi-Fi's AI Integration - The intersection of AI and Wi-Fi will redefine network management and user experiences in 2026.
6G's Architectural Shift - 6G will embed intelligence directly into networks, transforming design and operational efficiency.
Huawei's AI Revolution - Huawei emphasizes AI agents for operational efficiency and new revenue streams in telecom.
Activation Over Coverage - The broadband industry must focus on network activation and customer experience, not just coverage.
Japan's 5G Landscape - Despite near-universal coverage, 5G availability varies significantly across Japan's regions.
Ookla's Network Trends - Uplink performance will gain importance as AI-centric applications reshape network demands in 2026.
AI Infrastructure Predictions - The future of AI infrastructure will focus on intelligent design and network resilience.
